name: Get Sorted (No More Mind Games)
editorial_article: "Get Sorted (No More Mind Games)" is an emblematic electronic dance track released in 1997 by the project known as Cricket (3). Distributed primarily through the Netherlands-based label Spotsound Records, the release highlights the energetic and synthesizer-driven sounds typical of the late 1990s European dance scene. As a track, it is best known for its driving, beat-heavy production and vocal hooks that defined the radio and club landscapes of the era. The release saw multiple formats, including 12-inch vinyl and various CD single editions, reflecting its broad distribution across Europe during its peak activity. By synthesizing elements of trance and pop, Cricket managed to capture a specific aesthetic of the late-nineties club culture, bridging the gap between underground dance music and more accessible, radio-friendly formats. The project's involvement with Spotsound Records further solidified its place within the vibrant electronic music ecosystem of the Benelux region, which was then a crucial hub for dance production and distribution. Though largely a snapshot of a particular moment in 1997, "Get Sorted" remains a testament to the high-production-value dance music that defined the decade's closing years. The track stands as a representative entry for the project, showcasing their commitment to rhythmic intensity and melodic accessibility. For those interested in the evolution of Euro-trance and 90s dance, this track serves as an accessible touchstone for the era's stylistic hallmarks.
